armySpecialRules.name: Elven Grace
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+)
special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be
used against enemies that attack before the model with
Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: Fiery Breath
armySpecialRules.description:
A model with this special rule has a Strength 4 Breath
Weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: Lileath'S Blessing
armySpecialRules.description: A Wizard with this special rule gains a +1 dispel bonus.

armySpecialRules.name: Martial Prowess
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule may re-roll all To Hit
rolls of 1 when making close combat attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: Swordmaster
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule ignore Initiative penalties
from great weapons and gain the Dodge (6+) special
rule against non-magical missile attacks with Strength
3 or below (except templates).

armySpecialRules.name: Valour Of Ages
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule re-roll all failed Panic
tests caused by Dark Elves.

armySpecialRules.name: Bow Of Avelorn
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 4 Armour Piercing (1),
Flaming Attacks,
Magical Attacks,
Multiple Shots (2)*,
Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved.
Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: Elven Shortbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
16/24" 3 Armour Piercing (1),
March & Shoot,
Multiple Shots (2)*,
Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not marched.
Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: Elven Longbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 3 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (2)*,
Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved.
Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: Dragon Armour
armySpecialRules.description:
Heavy armour. Models with dragon armour gain a
Magical Ward (6+) and the Immunity (Flaming
Attacks) special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: Lion Cloak
armySpecialRules.description:
The bearer gains the Natural Armour (6+) special rule
against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Deathsinger
magicItems.description:
At the beginning of each round of close combat, roll a
D3; the result is the number you may increase the
wielder's Weapon Skill, Strength and Attacks by.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Ages
magicItems.description:
The Sword of Ages gives the wielder +1 To Hit, +2
Strength and +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Blade Of The Phoenix
magicItems.description:
The Blade of the Phoenix gives the wielder the Ignores
Armour Saves special rule. Once per battle, at the start
of any close combat phase the wielder can unleash the
full power of the sword. For the remainder of that close
combat phase, they get the Always Strikes First special
rule and +D6 Attacks.

magicItems.name: Bow Of The Seafarer
magicItems.description:
Lothern Sea Helm only. The Bow of the Seafarer is a
Bolt Thrower.

magicItems.name: Cloudcleaver
magicItems.description:
Polearm. All attacks made with Cloudcleaver have the
Ignores Armour Saves special rule. In addition, it gives
the wielder the Fear special rule and against War Beasts
and Cavalry, they cause Terror.

magicItems.name: Spear Of The Shores
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. This weapon gives the wielder +1
Strength and +2 Attacks.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Victory
magicItems.description:
The Sword of Victory gives the wielder the Always
Strikes First and Armour Piercing (1) special rules. In
addition, they will always Wound on a 3+ or better.

magicItems.name: The Reaver Bow
magicItems.description:
Elven shortbow. The Reaver Bow has the following
profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
20/30" 5 Armour Piercing (1),
March & Shoot,
Multiple Shots (3)
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the High
found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: The Blade Of Leaping Gold
magicItems.description:
The Blade of Leaping Gold grants the wielder +3
Attacks. In addition, any roll of 6 To Wound made with
the Blade of Leaping Gold Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Darting Steel
magicItems.description:
The Blade of Darting Steel gives the wielder +1 To Hit
and the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Hoeth
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. All hits with the Sword of Hoeth wound
automatically. Armour saves are modified by the
Strength of the bearer.

magicItems.name: Dragonblade Lance
magicItems.description:
Heavy lance. During turns in which the wielder of the
Dragonblade Lance charges, it automatically hits all
models in one file that is in base contact rather than
fighting normally. Hits are resolved as that from a Bolt
Thrower, except the Strength does not decrease for
each rank.

magicItems.name: Jade Bow
magicItems.description:
Elven Longbow. All shots from the Jade Bow are
resolved at Strength 4. In addition, if you successfully
Wound your target, you may fire an additional shot
against the same target. You may continue to fire
additional shots until you fail to Hit, Wound or the
target is dead.

magicItems.name: Foe Bane
magicItems.description:
Against Monstrous Infantry, Monstrous Cavalry,
Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures and Monsters,
this sword will always wound on a 2+.

magicItems.name: Bow Of Tor Alessi
magicItems.description:
Elven Longbow. The Bow of Tor Alessi has the Quick
Shot special rule. In addition, it may re-roll any failed
To Hit rolls.

magicItems.name: The Golden Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. Infantry or Cavalry only. Enemies must re-roll
all successful To Hit rolls against the bearer of the
Golden Shield.

magicItems.name: Helm Of Fortune
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The Helm of Fortune gives
the wearer a 6+ armour save. The wearer may re-roll
failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Heroes
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. In order to allocate close combat attacks
against the wearer, each enemy model must first pass a
Leadership test at the start of each close combat phase.
If the test is failed, the model may not attack at all this
round.

magicItems.name: Dragonscale Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. The Dragonscale Shield adds an additional +1
armour save as well as the Magical Ward (6+) special
rule.

magicItems.name: Shield Of Ithinar
magicItems.description:
Shield. All close combat attacks against the bearer
suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Temakador'S Gauntlets
magicItems.description:
Temakador's Gauntlets gives the wearer a 6+ armour
save. In addition, they gain the Magical Ward (5+)
special rule against attacks of Strength 4 or greater.

magicItems.name: Wyrmscale Armour Of The Deep
magicItems.description:
Heavy Armour. The Wyrmscale Armour of the Deep
gives the wearer the Aquatic and Immunity (Flaming
Attacks) special rules.

magicItems.name: Shadow Armour
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Light armour. The wearer gains the
Strider special rule. In addition, no enemies can draw
Line of Sight to them unless they are within 6".

magicItems.name: Armour Of Stars
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Light armour. If the wearer of the
Armour of Stars suffers an unsaved wound (but is not
slain) they can choose to instantly teleport 3D6" in a
random direction (placing it at least 1" away from other
units or impassable terrain) with its front arc in a
direction of your choosing. If the model teleports off
the table, then treat this as it having pursued off the
table.

magicItems.name: Shield Of The Merwyrm
magicItems.description:
Shield. The bearer of the Shield of the Merwyrm gains
the Parry (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Pinion Of The Phoenix
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The Pinion of the Phoenix gives
the wearer the Magical Ward (5+) special rule. If the
bearer is slain, the item is destroyed but restores the
bearer to their starting Wound total and inflicts a
Strength 5 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule on
all models in base contact.

magicItems.name: Vambraces Of Defence
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The bearer gains the Magical
Ward (4+) special rule. In addition, they may re-roll
failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: Null Stone
magicItems.description:
No model in base contact with the bearer of the Null
Stone may cast spells, and all Magic Items lose their
effects; treat them as mundane versions of the same
type.

magicItems.name: Folariath'S Robe
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The wearer of Folariath's Robe
gains the Ethereal special rule.

magicItems.name: Guardian Phoenix
magicItems.description:
The Guardian Phoenix gives the wearer the Immunity
(Flaming Attacks) and Magical Ward (5+) special rules.

magicItems.name: Loremaster'S Cloak
magicItems.description:
The wearer of the Loremaster's Cloak gains the
Magical Ward (3+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: The Signet Of Athinol
magicItems.description:
Any attacks made against the bearer suffer a -1
Strength penalty.

magicItems.name: Sacred Incense
magicItems.description:
All missile attacks targeted at the bearer of the Sacred
Incense or the unit they are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Golden Crown Of Atrazar
magicItems.description:
The Golden Crown of Atrazar gives the bearer the
Magical Ward (4+) and Stupidity special rules. In
addition, at the start of each of your turns, they suffer
-1 to their Leadership. This penalty is cumulative.

magicItems.name: Phoenix Stone
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. Every time the bearer of this
item rolls a natural 6 on their armour save or
invulnerable save roll, they restore 1 Wound suffered
earlier during game.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of Blinding Light
magicItems.description:
All enemy units in base contact with the bearer suffer
-1 to their Weapon Skill in the first round of close
combat.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of Saphery
Amulet Of Fire
magicItems.description:
The Amulet of Fire gives the wearer the Immunity
(Flaming Attacks) and Magic Resistance (1) special
rules.

magicItems.name: Book Of Hoeth
magicItems.description:
Relic. The Book of Hoeth allows the bearer to re-roll a
single dice from each of his casting or dispel attempts.
Results of 6 cannot be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Annulian Crystal
magicItems.description:
Relic. During the enemy's Magic phase, the Annulian
Crystal allows you to remove one dice from the
opponent's Power dice pool and add it to your own
Dispel dice pool.

magicItems.name: Sigil Of Asuryan
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. When an enemy cast a spell, the
bearer may use this item instead of attempting to dispel
the spell by using dispel dice. This gives them 6 free
dice to attempt to dispel the spell, which cannot be
combined with any other dispel dice. In addition, the
spell is destroyed and the enemy caster loses access to
the spell for the rest of the game (note that this has no
effect on Bound spells).

magicItems.name: Seerstaff Of Saphery
magicItems.description:
Staff. The Seerstaff of Saphery gives the bearer the
Loremaster special rule.

magicItems.name: Trickster'S Pendant
magicItems.description:
Relic. If an enemy Wizard suffers a Miscast, the bearer
of the Trickster's Pendant can choose to make the
Wizard re-roll the result on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: Starwood Staff
magicItems.description:
Staff. The Starwood staff gives the bearer a +1 casting
bonus. In addition, they may re-roll one failed
channelling roll per turn.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Solidity
magicItems.description:
Staff. One use only. The Staff of Solidity makes the
Wizard immune to the effects of their first Miscast.

magicItems.name: Jewel Of The Dusk
magicItems.description:
Relic. The Jewel of the Dusk gives the bearer +1 Power
dice in each of your Magic phases. Only they may use
this extra dice.

magicItems.name: Vortex Shard
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. The bearer may use the Vortex
Shard at the start of any enemy Magic phase. Your
opponent must remove D3 power dice from their
power pool.

magicItems.name: Silver Wand
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of the Silver Wand may pick a spell
one level higher than they are normally allowed.

magicItems.name: Spell Crown Of Dusk
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains access to a
randomly generated Lvl 1 spell (which may be replaced
by the Signature Spell) from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: Radiant Gem Of Hoeth
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Radiant Gem of Hoeth becomes a
Level 1 Wizard using the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: Khaine'S Ring Of Fury
magicItems.description:
Bound spell. Khaine's Ring of Fury contains the Fury
of Khaine spell from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: Moranion'S Wayshard
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. The bearer of Moranion's
Wayshard and one friendly Infantry unit they must
deploy with has the Ambushers special rule. Instead of
arriving as Reinforcements, they may choose to deploy
in any non-impassable terrain feature in the turn they
arrive.

magicItems.name: Pendant Of Vengeance
magicItems.description:
When fighting Dwarfs, the bearer may force a
successful Leadership test while using an Anvil of
Doom or Rune Lore to be rerolled.

magicItems.name: Ring Of Corin
magicItems.description:
Bound spell. The Ring of Corin contains the Vaul's
Unmaking spell from the Lore of High Magic.

magicItems.name: Sky Arrow Of Naloer
magicItems.description:
Model with non-magical Elven Longbow only. One use
only. This item cannot be used with the Sniper special
rule. The Sky Arrow of Naloer has the following
profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 6 Magical Attacks,
Multiple Wounds (D6)
magicItems.restriction: Model with non-magical Elven Longbow only.

magicItems.name: Skeinsliver
magicItems.description:
The Skeinsliver allows the controlling player to add +1
to the roll to determine which player can decide
whether to take the first turn or not.

magicItems.name: Blessed Tome
magicItems.description: The model gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Gem Of Sunfire
magicItems.description:
One use only. At the start of any of your turns, when
the Gem of Sunfire is used, all of the bearer's spells,
shooting attacks and close combat attacks (and their
mount's, if they have one) have a +1 bonus To Wound
(rolls of 1 still fail) provided that they also have the
Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Horn Of Isha
magicItems.description:
Handmaiden of the Everqueen only. One use only. The
Horn of Isha can be used at the start of one of your
Movement phases. For the remainder of the turn, all
models in the bearer's unit receive a +1 To Hit bonus
on all shooting and close combat attacks.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of The Purifying Flame
magicItems.description:
Enemy spells that target the character or the unit they
are with suffer a -3 casting penalty.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of The Tempest
magicItems.description:
Storm Weaver or Mist Weaver only. Enemy Wizards
within 12" of the bearer do not gain any casting bonus
from their Wizard Level.
magicItems.restriction: Storm Weaver or Mist Weaver only.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of Beards
magicItems.description:
The wearer of the Cloak of Beards causes Fear. Against
Dwarfs, the wearer causes Terror instead. However, all
Dwarfs gain the Hatred special rule while attacking the
wearer. In addition, at the start of each Close Combat
phase, roll a D6 for each magic item carried by each
Dwarf that is in base contact with the bearer. On a roll
of 4+, that magic or runic item is destroyed and cannot
be used for the rest of the battle; it will count as a
mundane version of whatever item it is instead. Note
that this has no effect on magic items that are mounts,
war machines, magic items that contain bound spells
that have already miscast during the game, and any
magic items labelled as 'one use only' that have already
been used during the game - do not roll to see if these
magic items are destroyed.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Light
magicItems.description:
All close combat attacks made by the bearer of the
Amulet of Light and any unit they are with gain the
Magical Attacks special rule.
GEM OF COURAGE* 10 points
One use only. The bearer of the Gem of Courage and
any unit they are with may take any one Leadership
test using the Cold-blooded special rule.
magicItems.restriction:
All close combat attacks made by the bearer of the
Amulet of Light and any unit they are with gain the
Magical Attacks special rule.
GEM OF COURAGE* 10 points
One use only.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of Loec
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Talisman of Loec may be used at the
start of any close combat phase. Until the end of the
phase, the bearer may re-roll all failed rolls To Hit and
wound, and any model wounded by their attacks must
re-roll all successful armour saves and invulnerable
saves. However, at the end of the phase, the bearer
loses half of their remaining Wounds (rounding down)
with no saves of any kind allowed.

magicItems.name: Star Ruby
magicItems.description:
At the start of each of your turns, all enemy units
within 12" must reveal any Hidden models, upgrades
and magic items they might have.

magicItems.name: Battle Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains a +D6 Combat
Resolution bonus (roll each time it is used).

magicItems.name: Banner Of The World Dragon
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard has the Magic
Resistance (5) special rule. Furthermore, all Draconids
(friend or foe) within 12" of the Banner of the World
Dragon have the Stubborn special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Resilience
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 Toughness.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Balance
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard, and any enemy unit in
base contact with it, gain the Immunity (Psychology)
special rule, and any Frenzy or Hatred special rule have
no effect.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Sorcery
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard adds +1 Power dice to
your power pool in each of your own Magic phases.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Ellyrion
magicItems.description:
Ellyrian Reavers only. The unit carrying this standard
gains +1 Movement and the Strider special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Avelorn
magicItems.description:
Handmaiden of the Everqueen or Sisters of Avelorn
only. Spells from the Lore of Light and the Lore of
Life cast by a friendly Wizard that target the unit
carrying this standard receive a +2 casting bonus. If
Alarielle the Radiant is included in your army and is
slain, this ability is immediately lost.
magicItems.restriction:
Handmaiden of the Everqueen or Sisters of Avelorn
only.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Lothern
magicItems.description:
Lothern Sea Guard only. The unit carrying this
standard gains the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Lion Standard
magicItems.description:
White Lions of Chrace only. The unit carrying this
standard gains the Immunity (Terror) special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Confidence
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard does not suffer -1 To
Hit when using Stand & Shoot as a charge reaction.
